title: Beneath a Dying Sun - Overflow
description: The overflow version of the modpack beneath a dying sun. (more content)
body:
![OVERFLOW](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/868041991c4f2f36c65e38f4506953ceda8338d3.png)

This is the overflow version of beneath a dying sun!
If you Don't know what overflow means here is the explanation: more content!
This modpack features other planets, more biomes (even overworld) and much more!
If you aren't familiar with the original "beneath a dying sun" here is some context. You will start in the undergarden. From there you gotta get tools and gear. the overworld is always available. it is above the undergarden and the nether is under the undergarden. so you are between heaven and hell :3 only that the sun is gonna make you burn...
That's it FOR NOW.
I hope you enjoy my modpack and have fun!

- Fischy
